title: They preached. They prayed. They performed.
paragraphs: They preached. They prayed. They performed.
But Jesus said… “I never knew you.”

Because deep down…
there’s a question you don’t want to ask out loud:

You sing the songs.
You post the verses.
You say “God bless.”

But when the lights are off…
when no one is watching…
🔥 The Quiet Danger Nobody Talks About
But ignore His voice in private

That split life.
That silent compromise.
That hidden addiction.
That pride dressed like “calling.”
📖 Scripture That Cuts Through the Illusion

“Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ shall enter the kingdom of heaven… Many will say to Me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in Your name… cast out demons… done many wonders?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you who practice lawlessness!’” — Matthew 7:21–23
💔 The Brutal Truth About False Converts
But whether you’ve been changed by God
Here’s the line that divides eternity:

Not: “You lost Me.”
Not: “You used to know Me.”
⚠️ This Is Where It Gets Personal
But it will never fool God.
“Man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart.” — 1 Samuel 16:7
You don’t need to be perfect to be saved.
“Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.” — 2 Corinthians 5:17

A new hunger.
A new direction.
A new heart.
This is not a message of condemnation.
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
“I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” — John 14:6
Jesus lived the life you couldn’t live.
He died the death you deserved.
So you don’t have to fake righteousness…
“Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out.” — Acts 3:19
“My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.” — John 10:27
Are you following Jesus… or just using His name?
Are you surrendered… or just spiritual?
This is not to shame you.
This is to wake you up.
💡 Here’s the Hope That Changes Everything
You are not too far gone.
“Whoever comes to Me I will never cast out.” — John 6:37

With your sin.
With your mess.
With your honesty.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
